summary: Senior frontend engineer with six years at Mastercard building React and TypeScript products, from independently deployed microfrontends to accessible design-system components. Improved UI load performance by 30% and WCAG compliance scores by 40%. Owns component architecture, state management, browser performance and API integration, with Python and AI engineering experience through FastAPI projects and the Nebius fellowship.

bullets: The UK programme covers **five modules**: AI agents, LLM architectures, MLOps, performance engineering and LLM post-training. Completed hands-on work across the first four modules, learning how to evaluate, deploy and monitor AI systems.
Built a **Python** research agent that checks figures in its answers against tool results, and a booking flow that applies business rules before confirming a request.
Built a small language model and improved its response time with **KV caching**; packaged training jobs for repeatable cloud runs.

Designed a **React and TypeScript** microfrontend platform with **Webpack Module Federation**, enabling **10+ product teams** to deploy modules independently and reducing release coordination from days to hours.
Built the host shell with **Redux Toolkit and RTK Query**; defined shared-dependency, routing and versioning contracts so independently shipped modules worked together.
Led accessibility work across React components and the internal design system, lifting **WCAG compliance scores by 40%**; coached **10+ teams** on semantic markup, focus management and ARIA.
Improved UI load performance by **30%** through **Akamai CDN** migration and bundle-delivery optimisation; instrumented client-side traces and core web vitals with Grafana and OpenTelemetry.
Translated product requirements into technical specifications, Figma prototypes and release-ready features while collaborating across frontend, backend and UX responsibilities.
Developed **Spring APIs** and flexible **PostgreSQL JSONB** forms behind the frontend, giving business teams new form fields without database migrations.
Built greenfield **React and TypeScript** applications with Redux and RTK Query, alongside Spring and Oracle services.
Migrated application routing from **React Router v5 to v6**, updating route definitions and navigation behaviour across the frontend.
Used **Fetch and AbortController** to cancel search requests when a new search superseded them or a component unmounted.
Moved non-DOM work, including observability/APM and date-library processing, into **Web Workers** to keep the main thread available for UI interaction.
Built a widget using the **CustomEvent API** to pass messages between the application and an external Drupal site.

Wrote Jest and React Testing Library unit tests and Playwright/Cypress end-to-end tests, achieving **95% test coverage**; split and parallelised the CI suite, cutting runtime from **eight hours to three**.
Designed high-fidelity **Figma** prototypes for product managers in **two days** when no UX designer was available.
Built **REST APIs** for Camunda workflow automation and delivered an **Angular.js** application through Grunt and Jenkins.
Developed an HSM integration for MDES tokenisation and remediated security findings from penetration tests.
Built a **Spring WebFlux** image-serving service for MDES CardArt, using ImageMagick compression and test-driven development.

projects.name: Web Accessibility Repair Platform
projects.description: Architected an end-to-end web-accessibility platform using LLM-guided Browser Use and Playwright to navigate public/authenticated pages and collect aligned HTML, axe-core, accessibility-tree, visual and screenshot data for 704 webpages; trained routed GAT/GraphSAGE specialists and generated schema-constrained repairs through FastAPI/React, improving page-level F1 by 34.1 points and rule-level F1 by 30.6 points over the initial architecture.

projects.name: Nebius Project
projects.description: Built a Repository Summarizer service using FastAPI and LLMs that generates human-readable summaries of GitHub repositories. Extracts code skeletons via AST and Tree-sitter to fit within token budgets, intelligently prioritizes source files, and assembles context within a 7000-token limit. This project secured admission into the Nebius AI Engineering Fellowship

awards.title: {Tech: Europe} Hackathon | London, UK | Most Secure Build Award (€1,000 cash)

Users search in plain English (e.g., "Ozempic in a pill"); an AI research agent expands the query into scientific keywords, searches PubMed/OpenAlex via Tavily, and returns an instant scorecard with drug target, disease, mechanism, and Commercial Viability score. Saved the corresponding author as a lead in Attio CRM; one-click R&D brief generation and a voice agent for hands-free review. Recognized by Aikido Security for the most secure codebase with zero issues detected, despite last-minute demo crunch in an npm ecosystem. Partners: Attio, Tavily, Google DeepMind.
